text:
zoe (partnerships): Team — new ask from Arbor: they want a ‘field reproducibility’ sweep in addition to lab runs. Objective: can our perf/W and knee numbers be reproduced on SI partner racks (their site) given the same kernel flags + probe data. Need plan for telemetry parity, data-sharing (NDA limited), and a compact workload matrix.

omar (perf-eng): Nice. So two lanes: Lab (full telemetry + probe) and Field (limited telemetry + pull of CSVs from SI). We'll need to lock down schema diffs. Proposed minimal field schema: pmbus.power_avg, host.rapl.package_avg, op.lat_ms_p50/p95, thermal.throttle_count, run_tag.

rachel (eng-runtime): For parity we should version telemetry schema and include a compatibility map. Field agents may not give PMBus at 10Hz; require a 1Hz min and an aggregated CSV format we can ingest. Example harness for lab: 

```bash
rw-bench run --model rdx-13b --seq 1024 --qps 120 --dur 40m --telemetry schema_v4.json --output s3://redwood-perf/arbor/1767894321/runA.jsonl
```

kevin @ArborCompute: We can coordinate with our SI (Suresh) to install probes and capture PMBus where available. SI prefers CSV drops (per-minute aggregates) and can't ship raw PMBus logs offsite due to policy. We'll share probe wiring and a sample aggregator.

suresh (systems-int): Confirmed. We'll run the field sweep on SI rack-12. We'll provide per-minute CSVs with columns: timestamp, card_id, power_w, temp_c, throttle_flag. Need to know which run_tags to map to which lab runs. Also: we need a short installer checklist (PSU, probe routing, BIOS preset).

maria (legal): Quick flag: data shared with SI must be under existing MSA/NDA. Marketplace blurb needs separate approval. Do not publish partner logos or numbers without explicit signoff.

zoe (partnerships): Noted — we'll only do an internal results page until legal signs off on any external comms. Action items below.

omar (perf-eng): Action items:
- I'll draft the workload matrix: seq points [256,512,1024], QPS ramps to find knee, plus a steady-state perf/W window (last 10m). Will include quantized vs fp16 toggles.

rachel (eng-runtime): Action items:
- telemetry schema v4 with compatibility map (lab vs field). Include fields: pmbus.power_avg (W), host.rapl.package_avg (W), op.lat_ms_p50/op.lat_ms_p95, batch.lat_p95, thermal.throttle_count, run_tag, git_shas.
- small agent for SI to produce CSV aggregator (per-minute).

kevin @ArborCompute: Action items:
- share probe wiring + sample aggregator by Tue. Confirm SI contact (suresh) has access.

suresh (systems-int): Action items:
- validate installer checklist, run field sweep May 25-26 window, provide CSVs to s3 drop with restricted ACL for redwood_arbor_team.

maria (legal): Action items:
- confirm NDA carveouts and draft a short data-sharing appendix (ETA Wed).

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Arbor field-repro & lab sweep" May 24 09:00 PT (lab prep), May 25-26 08:00 PT (field + lab runs).

omar (perf-eng): A couple of technical asks:
- Please include kernel flags and exact runtime git SHAs in every run_tag.
- For perf/W: we'll report instantaneous perf/W time-series and final steady-state avg (last 10m). For field results, we'll compute perf/W using SI CSV power_w and our op counts; annotate sampling rate diff.

rachel (eng-runtime): Agreed. Also will include a small sanity smoke script for SI to validate probes: 

```bash
# SI smoke check
si-smoke --target rack-12 --verify-pmbus --verify-csv --tag si-smoke-001
```

suresh (systems-int): We'll run the smoke check a day before and share logs. If we hit thermal throttles in field, we'll note ambient temp and PSU part numbers.

zoe (partnerships): One more: if numbers reproduce within 5% perf/W we can consider a co-validated badge for marketplace (still legal/marketing signoff required). If not, we'll capture divergence root causes in the post-run doc.

maria (legal): Understood. I'll prepare legal checklist for any external badge wording.

omar (perf-eng): I'll push the workload matrix CSV to s3://redwood-perf/arbor/1767894321/workload_matrix.csv by EOD Thu.

rachel (eng-runtime): Opening PR with schema_v4.json and SI agent script. I'll also include a conversion tool to normalize per-minute CSV -> jsonl.

kevin @ArborCompute: Kit ETA May 22 for lab; SI probes already on order, arriving May 23. Wiring docs in DM.

suresh (systems-int): ack. We'll block rack-12 May 24-26 and leave serial console access.

zoe (partnerships): Great. We'll use this thread for rapid updates only. After runs we'll collate a short internal report (numbers + divergence analysis) and then route for legal/marketing if a badge is desired. Thanks everyone :raised_hands)
